# SparkLab — Impressão 3D sob encomenda em Portugal

> SparkLab is a small 3D-printing workshop based in Portugal. We sell 3D-printed
> collectibles, keychains, mugs/can holders and custom made-to-order parts, and we
> offer a custom 3D printing + modeling service. Everything is printed in-house on
> Bambu Lab P1S printers and shipped anywhere in Portugal via registered CTT mail.
> Site content is in Portuguese (pt-PT) with an English toggle.

## Key facts

- Website: https://www.sparklab3d.pt
- Country / service area: Portugal (mainland and islands). We ship only within Portugal.
- Language: Portuguese (pt-PT); English available via on-site toggle.
- Founders: Israel Vieira (dev) and Pamela Falk (3D maker). Local production, no mass manufacturing.
- Equipment: Bambu Lab P1S (enclosed chamber). Max single-print volume: 256 × 256 × 256 mm (larger pieces are printed in modular parts).
- Materials: PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, PC (official Bambu Lab filaments).
- Catalog prices: roughly €3 (keychains) to €30 (collectible figures); mugs/can holders €15–20. Custom work is quoted individually.
- Shipping: registered CTT mail with tracking. Free shipping on orders over €40.
- Wholesale: automatic 15% discount on 10+ units of the same piece (customized variants count together), applied in the cart and at checkout. Larger volumes quoted individually; invoices for businesses.
- Payments: Visa and Mastercard via Stripe (secure checkout, card data never touches our servers).
- Custom quotes: send an STL/OBJ/3MF/STEP file (or just an idea — we also do 3D modeling) via the quote form; reply within ~2 business hours on WhatsApp.
- STL files of our original designs can be purchased for personal use (delivered via WhatsApp).
- Contact: WhatsApp +351 916 853 802 · https://wa.me/351916853802
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sparklabs.3d/

## How ordering works

1. Send your idea or 3D file (STL, OBJ, 3MF, STEP) — we assess print feasibility.
2. We fine-tune color, size, material and finish together over WhatsApp, with a clear quote.
3. We print on the Bambu Lab P1S, review, pack and ship via registered CTT mail.

## Guides (in-depth, citable answers)

- [How much does 3D printing cost in Portugal?](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias/quanto-custa-impressao-3d-portugal):
  the 4 price factors (material grams, machine time, finishing, one-time modeling fee),
  real catalog prices (€3 keychains to €30 figures), saving tips, shipping.
- [PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU or PC — which material to choose](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias/pla-petg-abs-asa-tpu-pc-qual-escolher):
  comparison table of all 6 materials (strength, heat, UV/outdoor use, relative price)
  and a rule of thumb: decorative→PLA, functional→PETG, outdoor→ASA, >90 °C or heavy load→ABS/PC, flexible→TPU.
- [How 3D printing is saving AI data centers](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias/impressao-3d-refrigeracao-inteligencia-artificial):
  the AI boom's massive heat problem and how 3D-printed liquid-cooling copper cold plates
  with complex internal geometries are solving it — what additive manufacturing brings
  that traditional machining can't.
- [3D printing in 2026: not just decoration — parts you actually use](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias/impressao-3d-pecas-funcionais-2026):
  the shift from gadget-phase to tool-phase — FDM now produces functional, replacement
  parts for cars, home repairs and custom tools. What changed (materials, enclosed
  printers, fine-tuning) and what it means for ordering custom parts.
- [The 3D printing market in 2026: desktop machines took the lead](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias/mercado-impressao-3d-2026):
  Q1 2026 market data — hardware revenue up 32% YoY, and desktop printers under US$2,500
  now generate 54% of all global 3D printing system revenue, more than every other price
  band combined, while the professional band shrank through cannibalisation. Also covers
  demand drivers (defence, foldable-phone titanium hinges, drones, print farms), healthcare
  growth (US$3.6B in 2025 to a projected US$23.4B by 2034), corporate moves (Creality IPO,
  Stratasys–Markforged, EOS, Formlabs) and new hardware (Bambu Lab A2L, Anycubic Kobra S1
  ACE 2 Pro, FlashForge AD5X).
- [Personalized 3D-printed gifts: ideas you can't buy in a store](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias/prendas-personalizadas-impressao-3d):
  real gift ideas with catalog prices — personalized mugs with a name (€20), team can
  holders (€15), keychains (€3–4), decorative boxes (€15), large collectible figures (€30) —
  plus made-to-order pieces from a photo/sketch (modeling paid once), honest lead times
  (a few business days; 1–2 weeks ahead in peak seasons) and a 15% automatic discount
  for 10+ units of the same piece (wedding favors, company giveaways).
- [All guides](https://www.sparklab3d.pt/guias)
